title: A (89,8,3) covering design with 2606 blocks
description: An explicit (89,8,3) covering design with 2606 blocks, covering all 113564 triples. The Covering Repository listed 2611 blocks on 31 October 2026, credited to Bluskov and Sidorenko. Obtained by post-optimisation of their design; includes the program and a verification script.
